name: Moder
prior: Energy transfer between modes exists in research and as one commercial claim, always upward or symmetric: DAFx 2023 paper 42 couples modal filters through an energy-transfer coefficient matrix with energy-conserving transfers (VS: dafx.de), Skare & Abel real-time GPU cymbals approximate modal coupling (VS: dafx.de), Chaigne/Touzé gong cascades are upward and research-only (V: research/synthesis.md §2.17 via biologist.md), EURASIP 2024 impact sounds add random processes for realism (VS: springer). Commercial: reFX Rippler advertises 'bi-directional energy transfer between resonators' without technical detail (VS: refx.com/rippler, page blocked, unverified); AudioThing Materia can let low partials sustain while uppers decay, but with static per-partial envelopes and no transfer or crackle (VS: audiothing.net); Mod Wiggler 'sounds of decay' thread recommends Cocoquantus/feedback on the verge of collapse (VS). In-app: Gong bloom fakes upward bloom with delayed fade-ins, Schale/Glocke are linear (V: code-map). Unoccupied after 3 searches (1 extended): downward spectral digestion with a swelling fundamental and tuned per-mode crackle as a struck instrument.

cost_detail.L1: 8 rotations ≈ 0.28 + node 0.06 + 1–2 k-rate params 0.03–0.06 + digestion ODE per block (8 states, negligible) + crackle as specified (JS 2-pole bandpass per burst ≈ 30 ns/sample while a burst runs, duty 10–100 % → 0.03–0.25) → ≈ 0.45–0.65; with crackle as AM of the mode itself (mode_k × (1 + c·burst noise) = tuned sidebands at f_k for free) ≈ 0.45
cost_detail.fallback: native: 8 biquads ≈ 0.85 (V §4) + tick()-driven gain automation of the ODE (25 ms) + noise BufferSource bursts ≈ 1.1 (Schale class) → possible but worklet preferred

failure_modes: [M] The signature swell does not happen as specified: simulating Ṗ_k = −P_k/τ_k − d_k·P_k + η·d_{k+1}·P_{k+1} (D 0.5, η 0.6, τ_1 5 s, τ_k = 5/k, bright strike with the fundamental at −10.5 dB) gives the fundamental +0.6 dB (y 0.5), +1.8 dB (y 1.0), +2.7 dB with all τ long; the nearest-neighbour chain bottlenecks at d_2 = 0.07/s (d_k ∝ (k/K)^1.5) and multiplies η losses per hop, so energy parks in modes 2–4. Routing 70 % of every digested packet straight to the stem yields +7.4 / +9.3 dB peaking at 1.4–1.5 s – audible. Direct-to-stem flow, d_k ≥ 0.5/s for k ≥ 2 and a quiet fundamental at strike are requirements, not options.

[V APP] `decayMul` is never set anywhere in the app (grep: 0 setters, only `o.decayMul || 1` consumers); seqTick/laneHit pass only `gate = stepDur·0.9`. A struck engine that 'ignores gate' lives its full Nachklang (5 s) per hit → at 8 hits/s ≈ 40 Moder voices → steal() removes released voices by progress and cuts the 1–3 s swell before it happens in any fast lane. Digestion speed must scale from `o.gate` (short step = fast compost) and finish at −60 dB.

Continuous transfer sounds like a lowpass sweep plus swell (the idea's own risk); Poisson filtered-noise bursts sound like vinyl unless tuned (AM of the mode) and sparse (≤ 20/s per mode); the per-mode 'piece breaks off' event is what separates digestion from a filter.
Dry end (y low) ≈ an ordinary Glocke/Schale – overlap with three existing struck engines; identity exists only for y ≥ 0.4 → default lane brightness mid-high.

A swelling pure sine fundamental is a 'wub'/test tone; tanh adds odd harmonics only when hot; give the stem a share of mode 2 or soft even harmonics; phone speakers lose f < 300 Hz, so low notes' hum vanishes on phones (A).
Sporenregen (RG_S candidate): hundreds of 5-s tails become a continuous hum + crackle bed – feature or mud; RG_VMAX caps count but not the bed.
fixes: ODE: direct-to-stem fraction ≈ 0.7 of each digested packet, d_k floor 0.5/s for k ≥ 2, Schlägel default bright (fundamental −10 dB at strike), η ≥ 0.6
digestion rate and τ scaled by o.gate (lanes) with decayMul kept as a no-op; finish at ΣP < −60 dB
crackle as per-mode AM with 2–8 ms noise grains (tuned sidebands), ≤ 20 events/s per mode, amplitude ∝ √(digested power)
stem body: mode-2 share or soft even harmonics; default Höhe ≥ 0.5
polyphony note in VCOST: 14 / 0.55 ≈ 25 voices at L1 mobile
verdict: Selten: Energieaustausch zwischen Moden gibt es als Forschung (DAFx 2023 gekoppelte Filter, Chaigne/Touzé-Gongs, Skare/Abel-Becken – alle aufwärts) und als Werbesatz (reFX Rippler: „bidirektionaler Energietransfer zwischen Resonatoren“, unbelegt); Materia lässt tiefe Teiltöne stehen und hohe sterben, aber statisch – die Verdauung nach unten mit gestimmtem Knistern ist unbesetzt. Worklet-machbar, ≈ 0,55 Einheiten (Knistern als AM der Mode statt eigenem Bandpass macht es fast gratis), Stufe 3 ≈ 0,9. Wie geschrieben versagt der Kern messbar: die Nachbar-Kette mit d_k ∝ (k/K)^1,5 und η = 0,6 je Stufe bringt dem Grundton nur +0,6 bis +2,7 dB (Simulation), die Energie bleibt in Mode 2–4 stecken – erst mit direktem Fluss zum Stamm (≈ 70 % jedes verdauten Pakets), d_k ≥ 0,5/s und leisem Grundton beim Schlag schwillt er um +7–9 dB bei 1,4 s an; außerdem setzt die App `decayMul` nirgends und Spuren geben nur `gate` weiter, sodass jeder Schlag volle 5 s lebt und `steal()` bei 8 Schlägen/s die Schwellen wegstiehlt – Verdauung muss aus `gate` skalieren. Mit diesen Korrekturen eine wirklich eigene Perkussion (umgekehrte Hüllkurve + Knistern als Signatur), sonst eine Glocke mit Tiefpassfahrt.
